```{r setup, message=FALSE}
# Locate the project root robustly whether Knit is clicked from the project
# folder, the reports folder, or run through rmarkdown::render().
find_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  here <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(here, "config.yml")) &&
        file.exists(file.path(here, "R", "00_setup.R"))) {
      return(here)
    }
    parent <- dirname(here)
    if (identical(parent, here)) {
      stop("Could not locate the project root containing config.yml and R/00_setup.R.")
    }
    here <- parent
  }
}

PROJECT_ROOT <- find_project_root()
setwd(PROJECT_ROOT)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = PROJECT_ROOT)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
source(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "R", "00_setup.R"))
source(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "R", "01_import_clean.R"))
```
